The synthetic arm for C4, C5 and C6 is finished and delivered to `paper-repo` `dev` under `code/results/`. The real-data runs still wait on the matrix, which was at about 175 of 504 blocks when last checked.

**Delivered files:**
- `decision_rates_synthetic.parquet` (C4)
- `protocols_synthetic.parquet` (C5)
- `bound_coverage_synthetic.parquet` (C6)
- the raw rows, plus a README paragraph for each file

I posted the file names, columns and findings on #5 and a pointer on #3. The intervals are t-intervals over 6–8 simulated worlds, with 500 draws per world and cell. The `K_eff` column is empty in these files, because I only define it for fitted real worlds.

**Results at the exact null** (N_tot = 120, random search with 100 configurations unless noted):
- **Naive report:** it exceeds the true accuracy in 100% of draws.
- **Other estimators:**

  | Estimator | Report exceeds truth |
  |---|---|
  | Optimism bootstrap | 90% |
  | .632 bootstrap | 97% |
  | Cross-fit | 54% |
  | 20% split | 47% |
  | 50% split | 55% |

- **Bounds over all 128 declared configurations:** max-t, Bonferroni and Šidák cover 96%, against the 95% nominal.
- **Bounds over the evaluated set:**
  - **Random search with 100 configurations, and hill-climb:** they cover 95%.
  - **Successive halving:** they cover only 48–65%, because its evaluated set is the last two survivors. For successive halving, C6 can only claim the declared-set bound.

I added the real-arm path to `summarise_protocols.py` but have not run it on real data. `summarise_decisions.py` is synthetic-only, so the real C4 file needs a variant.

**Matrix:** workers 5–9 are running, and I relaunch them as they hit their time limits. The real-data runs, `matrix_facts`, C7 and the leakage result follow once it finishes. The next job to finish will wake me.
